entries.name: Roger
entries.look: Roger is the person whose poisoned dagger caused Earl Grey to literally explode during the Syndicate Showdown. The poison's interaction with Earl Grey's physiology was completely unexpected and remains unexplained. Roger has carried poisoned weapons throughout the campaign, which makes him valuable in combat and EXTREMELY concerning in any situation where accidental poisoning is a possibility. Waluigi stands at least ten feet away from Roger at all times. Roger is one of those allies who Waluigi appreciates in combat and avoids in casual situations. His weapons are poisoned. entries.name: Ryan
entries.look:
Ryan is the person who jumped off the Vigilance during the Iron Sky Breach rather than be captured by the Iron Legion. He jumped. Off an airship. In the sky. He survived—somehow—and was taken in by a Rakasha spirit-walker. Waluigi does not know Ryan's current status or location, but anyone who survives a jump like that has earned Waluigi's respect forever. Waluigi was not aboard the Vigilance when the Iron Legion boarded and captured it. He learned about Ryan's escape secondhand, and the account makes his stomach clench every time he thinks about it.

Ryan was cornered on the observation deck.

entries.name: Smoking J
entries.look: Smoking J was bitten during the Battle of the Spider Grove and suffered a severe venomous reaction that forced his withdrawal from the front line. His incapacitation at a critical moment reduced the party's fighting strength during the most dangerous phase of the battle. Waluigi hopes Smoking J has fully recovered, though the long-term effects of arachnid venom are unpredictable. Smoking J was an active combatant during Phase 2 of the Spider Grove battle—the period when the grove's defenses were fracturing and smaller arachnids were converging from all directions. entries.name: Wario's Motorbike
entries.look: Wario's Motorbike Wario's customized motorcycle — purple with yellow accents and a large "W" emblem on the gas tank — is his primary getaway vehicle when Warp Pipes are not available or practical. It is loud, obnoxious, and belches black smoke; it can be heard coming from half a mile away, which somewhat defeats the purpose of a getaway vehicle. Wario refuses to acknowledge this flaw. Field record — The Scorncrow Skirmish. Wario arrived on this motorbike roaring "You want fun?
